executiveSummary: Active, multi-agency alert of targeting against Siemens S7 PLCs across U.S. critical infrastructure with concrete OT exploitation methods (S7comm, snap7); immediate hardening and segmentation recommended. Security Advisory Multiple unauthenticated remote-compromise paths on Advantech EKI-1242 industrial gateways (remote root on TCP/5058, unsigned firmware acceptance, OPC UA DoS) create direct process disruption risk; prioritize isolation and updates. Supporting Report PHP "php2shell" runtime RCE (CVE-2026-109618/109619) is under mass scanning and exploitation against public sites; immediate patching and DMZ-to-OT segmentation required to reduce IT-to-OT pivot risk. View Article Supporting Report Edge/VPN devices remain high-risk: active NetScaler ADC RCE exploitation and a critical BeyondTrust Remote Support auth bypass are enabling rapid enterprise compromise and potential OT pivots; patch and perform compromise hunts now. Security Advisory CISA Alert France's ANSSI reports ongoing intrusions against energy and water operators via internet-exposed HMIs/PLCs, including a wind farm shutdown; remove exposure, enforce VPN/MFA, and monitor industrial protocol writes. Supporting Report Ransomware and supply chain threats persist: SafePay ransomware is actively impacting critical sectors, and a LiteLLM package compromise stole secrets and shipped a backdoor-rotate keys and validate build provenance. Security Advisory View Article Notable OT advisories: Siemens SIMATIC S7 Webserver API library flaws (path traversal, password exposure) and Siemens building controllers (APOGEE/TALON/Desigo) unauthenticated DoS-apply updates and enforce OT network isolation. ICS Advisory ICS Advisory

items: APT41 "BlackX" bootkit revives BlackLotus techniques to bypass Secure Boot; while targets are diplomatic, persistence capability endangers engineering workstations. View Article
"Prince of Persia" (Iran) operating U.S.-hosted C2, multi-stage malware over HTTPS/Telegram; identity-centric hardening recommended. View Article
Lazarus-linked scanning observed in ongoing PHP2Shell activity; watch for low-and-slow multipart probes and AD relay follow-on. View Article
#StopRansomware: SafePay active internationally against CI sectors; enforce MFA, segmentation, offline backups, and EDR. Security Advisory

relevance: Multiple items in this cycle directly affect industrial controllers, gateways, and building automation platforms, with credible evidence of active exploitation and pre-positioning (Siemens S7 PLCs; Advantech gateways; NetScaler and BeyondTrust enabling OT pivots). Mass exploitation of PHP services increases the likelihood of enterprise entry and lateral movement into poorly segmented OT perimeters. National-level advisories (CISA, CERT-FR/ANSSI) cite real-world operational disruptions and ongoing targeting of energy and water sectors.

items: Siemens SIMATIC S7 Webserver API .NET client library - path traversal arbitrary write and restore password exposure: update to V3.3.61/3.3.62+. ICS Advisory
Siemens APOGEE/TALON/Desigo PXC/PXM - unauthenticated remote DoS on web upload service; many legacy lines have no fix; segment and disable services by default. ICS Advisory
Danfoss iC7 drives - exposed debug/service interfaces and unsigned firmware/app loading enabling sabotage risk; segment and apply vendor updates. Weekly Summary
Advantech EKI-1242 EIMS/IEIMS - remote root, unsigned firmware acceptance, web command injection; block TCP/5058, update firmware. Weekly Summary
Advantech WISE-6610 LoRaWAN gateways - public exploits for RCE; remove internet exposure and update. Weekly Summary
AVEVA Pipeline Integrity Monitor - sensitive project data/weak hashes; rotate secrets and patch. Weekly Summary
Brotli decoder (CVE-2026-111497) - RCE in libbrotli affecting Node.js/Envoy/Istio; patch and consider disabling Brotli temporarily. View Article
PHP runtime RCE (CVE-2026-109618/109619) - patch to 8.2.35/8.3.36/8.4.27/8.5.12; disable upload progress interim. JPCERT Advisory

descriptions: Initial Access: Exploit Public-Facing Application (T1190); Edge/VPN device RCE; Supply-chain package trojanization
Execution: Webshells on PHP; OS command injection on security middleware; DLL sideloading; UEFI bootkits
Persistence/Defense Evasion: Pre-OS persistence (UEFI); credential/token theft; abuse of default/weak credentials on OT devices
Lateral Movement: RDP/SMB/PsExec/WinRM; SD-WAN/BMS controller admin interfaces; OT gateways and management consoles
Command and Control: HTTPS/cloud storage APIs (Google Drive/OneDrive/Yandex); Telegram API; GitHub/Dropbox abuse
ICS-specific: Unauthorized Command Message to Controller (ATT&CK for ICS), Modify Controller Logic/Parameters; OPC UA session exhaustion (DoS)

outlook72h: - Prioritize patch windows for NetScaler ADC/Gateway, BeyondTrust Remote Support, and PHP across internet-facing assets; validate with compromise hunts post-update. - Isolate and ACL OT gateways and building controllers; remove any residual internet exposure and enforce jump-host-only access paths. - Run targeted hunts in SIEM/EDR for web shells, anomalous PHP multipart POSTs, unexpected PLC writes (S7comm), and new admin sessions on edge devices. - Stage and test ICS firmware/client library updates (Siemens S7 Webserver API); rotate exposed restore passwords/secrets found in logs. - Review vendor advisories in recent CISA weekly summaries for OT-relevant components (Advantech WISE-6610, Danfoss iC7, AVEVA PIM) and schedule risk-based remediation.
